international.title: Apec summit live: Xi and Putin give opening speeches as world leaders gather in China
international.summary: Summit in Chinese tech hub Shenzhen set to include highly anticipated meeting between Xi, Trump and Putin Shenzhen takes centre stage as Xi sends ‘Chinamaxxing’ message at Apec summit What is Apec? Explained in 30 seconds The Asia Group’s George Chen is at the CEO summit and sent the Guardian some thoughts on Xi’s speech, which he said was “largely expected”, featuring technology and innovation prominently. Xi positioned China as “a force for stability and predictability in an increasingly uncertain world”, he said. While Xi never mentioned export controls, Nvidia or the United States directly in his speech, the underlying message was unmistakable: China intends to pursue a more open and cooperative approach to technology development. That message is likely to resonate with many countries in the Global South and reinforces Beijing’s effort to contrast its technology strategy with that of Washington.” Continue reading...
